name: Shimobe Rei
source:
"I want you to tell me everything you know about the Founder's murder."

Founder of the Shuten Order who was resurrected in a “temporary body”. All memories prior to being murdered were lost. ”Rei Shimobe” is a temporary name to hide their identity as the Founder. Disguised as a detective to find the murderer within the given time limit: dawn, four days from now…

[From [url=https://shuten-kyodan.com/en/character/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Rei is actually a hive-mind droid with multiple spare bodies. Her "Power of God" abilities allow her to hack other droids, and her "resurrections" are spare bodies activated upon her death. Five different spare bodies were activated at the same time to investigate each Minister, which Rei mistook as 5 different timelines (routes).[/spoiler]
